caption: The drawing depicts a round object that resembles a shallow dish or plate with a decorative, ornate handle at the top. The dish is shaded to indicate its form, giving it a metallic or polished appearance with gradient pencil shading from light to dark. The handle is composed of a series of rounded and teardrop-shaped cutouts arranged symmetrically, with a central circular cutout at the top and two larger teardrop-shaped cutouts on either side at the base of the handle. The overall drawing is done in grayscale, with pencil shading creating depth and contour. The main object is enclosed within a lightly drawn rectangular border, with a smaller, inset rectangular diagram in the upper right corner detailing the shape and dimensions of an elongated oval or spoon-like element, including marked measurements. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing. The background is plain and unshaded, leaving the focus on the depicted object and its details.
title: Silver Porringer
